review_notes:
I read all 51 lines of the file. It has one definition, `multipointConstant`, and two proofs:
- `multipointConstant_pos` is `unfold` followed by `positivity`.
- `RegularSLEPresentation.physical_multipoint_main` builds one helper fact (`hBm`) and then makes a single `simpa only` call to `Multipoint.capped_physical_radius_multipoint_bound`.

No nontrivial reasoning appears in two proofs in this file, so there is nothing for a shared lemma to replace.

The `hBm` step does repeat across the project. I searched for it and found the same call (`measurable_uncurry_of_continuous_of_measurable a.continuous_B a.measurable_B`) in about 15 other SLE files, including WindowTails, StochasticFubini, GreenCovariance and FiniteMass. However, it is a one-line use of an existing Mathlib lemma. A shared helper would only be a thin wrapper around existing API, which the rubric says is not enough. A field or lemma on `RegularSLEPresentation` could remove some boilerplate across the project, but this file has only one copy, so I am not reporting it as a finding for this file.
